relations: Exploding fireworks project bright, expanding light onto the water surface below.
The rippling water distorts and reflects the vertical streaks of city lights.
As fireworks expand and fade, their colorful reflections ripple and shift on the water.
The dark water surface mirrors the illuminated skyline and the bursts of fireworks above.
